title: 36 Hours in Orlando, Fla.
abstract: Instead of theme parks, visitors will find multicultural activities and dining, urban sophistication, and a sense of history in what may be America’s most misunderstood city.

title: 36 Hours in Hong Kong
abstract: A weekend in a city where, perhaps above all else, it’s all about the views.

title: 36 Hours in Portland, Ore.
abstract: Below the fleece-clad and Teva-wearing exterior lurks a cool and refreshingly unneurotic city that marches to its own cosmopolitan beat.

title: 36 Hours in Dublin
abstract: Stylish restaurants, designer hotels and pricey shopping malls abound in the Irish capital. No, this compact Gaelic city is no longer the land of ramshackle pubs and baked-potato pushcarts.

title: 36 Hours in Key West, Fla.
abstract: Biking through Old Town at dusk, kayaking across the quiet, teal-blue ocean, or catching an old-timer’s tale, visitors can still catch a glimpse of what this laid-back island used to be like.
